messages:
anya: quick follow-up on the RFC about a shim/adapter between hosted/dedicated/private — want to lock the adapter shape and a few hard constraints before the POC.
ben: +1. main constraints i see: network isolation for private, auth surface differences, and how metrics/traces propagate.
chloe: also rollout semantics — hosted can do instant model swaps across pool, dedicated has reserved capacity, private is customer-pinned. need to capture that in the interface.
samir: thinking of a two-layer adapter: ControlPlaneAdapter (model metadata, rollouts, config translation) and DataPlaneAdapter (inference RPCs, health, metrics tags). keeps concerns separated.
irene: fine, but we must surface capability discovery — private might not support "burst" or "auto_quant". adapter should advertise supported feature set.
ben: propose a simple /capabilities vector from the adapter: ["batching","kv_cache","quantized","burst","streaming"]. control plane uses that to validate rollouts.
chloe: agree. also need canonical error taxonomy for fallback logic. e.g., 429 (rate) vs 503 (capacity) vs 403 (auth) — so control plane can pick fallback model or region.
anya: auth differences: hosted uses bearer tokens; private often uses mTLS or KMS-signed tokens. adapter should expose a small auth_adapter to translate control-plane credentials into provider-specific credentials.
samir: rough interface sketch:

```
interface ControlPlaneAdapter {
  getCapabilities(): Capabilities
  translateConfig(cp_config): provider_config
  triggerRollout(version): RolloutResult
  watchEvents(cb)
}
interface DataPlaneAdapter {
  infer(req): InferResp
  health(): HealthStatus
  metricsTags(): map[string]string
}
```

Keep control-plane payloads JSON-only. allow data-plane to support streaming (ws/grpc) for latency-sensitive paths.
chloe: +1. For translateConfig we should include a deterministic mapping so we can diff provider_config to detect drift.
irene: ops note — observability: adapters must propagate trace_id, route and model tags, and emit token-less aggregate metrics for enterprise customers (no PII).
ben: and include a small health/diagnostics payload: {uptime, queue_depth, last_model_hash} so the control plane can make routing decisions.
anya: decision summary: adopt adapter pattern with capability discovery, config translation, and an error taxonomy for fallbacks. keep control-plane stateless where possible; data-plane may keep connections/caches.
anya: action items: samir to prototype interfaces + mock adapters for aws-hosted, dedicated-k8s, private-agent. zhang to run matrix tests for rollout semantics and fallback cases.
deploy-bot: ticket INF-4123 created for adapter POC — https://tickets.internal/INF-4123 — assigned to samir, zhang.
deploy-bot: INF-4123 status: open, ETA 2w :calendar:
ben: can we also get security's input on auth translation before POC starts? @chloe will set up the sync.
chloe: will do, adding security and infra to the RFC thread and updating the pseudocode section.
anya: thanks all — this clears the major unknowns. we'll iterate on the exact RPC shapes in the prototype.
